<CLT=cltMIND>There are a lot of washing machines
in here...

<CLT=cltMIND>These are some powerful cleaning tools. You
could get a lot of cleaning done with these.
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's so clunky...
I wonder if that's just what Monokuma likes.

<CLT=cltMIND>This closet...used to have washing machines
and cleaning supplies in it...

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a doll at the dining table...
Perhaps a family dinner?
